# 4 bedroom bungalow for sale

> Sandon is a beautifully appointed detached bungalow with elegant, understated styling and enchanting gardens, set in a peaceful, semi-rural position on the northern edge of Salisbury. The property has been stylishly updated and enhanced and offers four bedrooms and two airy, comfortable reception rooms, with all the accommodation presented on a single, accessible level.

## Fakta
- Typ: bungalow
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bedrooms
- Plocha: 207 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Mill Lane, Stratford Sub Castle
- Cena: £950,000
